name: Maintaining my weight
line: Your calorie target is simply what you use. A choice, not a default - and the right one when you want to hold steady.

name: Maintaining my weight
line: Your calorie target is simply what you use. A choice, not a default - and the right one when you want to hold steady.

name: Losing fat
line: Your daily calorie target drops below what you use, gently - about half a percent of your weight a week - with a floor it will never go under. Protein stays high, because that is what protects muscle while you lose fat.

name: Losing fat
line: Your daily calorie target drops below what you use, gently - about half a percent of your weight a week - with a floor it will never go under. Protein stays high, because that is what protects muscle while you lose fat.

name: Gaining weight
line: Your calorie target rises a little above what you use: 150 kcal a day, and never more than that. Steady rather than fast, because faster is mostly fat and harder to keep. There is no target to reach and no date.
safety: If you have been losing weight without meaning to, it is worth telling your doctor. Selodía is not a medical service, and this is not a plan for recovering from an eating disorder - that needs a clinician. Either way this stays gentle: a small surplus, no target to reach and no date.

name: Building muscle
line: Your daily calorie target rises a little above what you use, to fuel training, and protein moves to the top of its range for recovery and new muscle.

name: Building muscle
line: Your daily calorie target rises a little above what you use, to fuel training, and protein moves to the top of its range for recovery and new muscle.

name: Less fat, more muscle
line: Your calorie target sits around what you use, not under it, and protein goes to the top of its range. The change comes from the protein and the training rather than from eating less. It is the slowest of these and the one that keeps the most muscle.
